Title: .NET Core support for Azure Analysis Services client libraries is in preview

Body.Content:
In response to customer feedback, .NET Core support for Azure Analysis Services client libraries is now available in preview. Start building .NET Core applications for modern cross-platform and cloud-oriented environments that target Analysis Services and Microsoft Power BI.

The new NuGet packages are equivalent to the existing Analysis Services Management Objects (AMO) and ADOMD.NET client packages for the .NET framework, which makes migration of existing applications to .NET Core straightforward. You can now use Azure Functions v2, PowerShell Core, ASP.NET Core, and other modern environments to connect to and manage your datasets.

Get started with the preview packages for AMO and ADOMD.NET.

 

Notes:

  • The libraries target .NET Core 3.0 and above. As .NET Core evolves and adds more capabilities, the Analysis Services client libraries might target a higher version by the time the libraries become generally available.
  • The initial version of the .NET Core libraries only supports Azure Analysis Services and Power BI. On-premises SQL Server Analysis Services is not supported.
